ryan: Weird transient decode hiccup; GPU pointer became invalid mid-request after compactor moved pages.
nina: Is this from soft-offload compaction?
ryan: Yep. Sequence: validate->use->compactor move->validate fails -> synchronous rebind ~22ms.
omar: Synchronous rebind on hot path is killer. Two options: reserve()/release() to prevent compaction or epoched handles with fast-validate+async-repair.
trace: reserve raises host residency risk under pressure. Epoch handles + a read-copy fallback for one request seems better.
omar: Add leader-election for remap: first waiter remaps, others wait short deadline then read-copy. Keeps remap work bounded.
ryan: Proposed API: reserve(lease_ms)/release(), handle.validate(epoch)->bool, handle.refresh_async(). Telemetry: invalidation_count, rebind_latency_hist, per-tenant compaction_rate.
trace: Compactor must grab tenant token so epoch bump is atomic wrt moves. Document in RFC and canary rollout.
infra-bot: canary deploy "epoch-handles-p0" started to 8% infra.
nina: Perf targets: read-copy <5ms p99; async remap <30ms 99th. We'll run microbench and canary.
ryan: I'll open RFC with microbench links. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
